description.fun: Meltan is a little blob of liquid metal with a hex nut for a head, and it eats metal by dissolving it, turning it into electricity that it fires from its eye. When a Melmetal reaches the end of its life, it rusts and crumbles, and its shards are reborn as Meltan; one day a strong Meltan absorbs the rest of its group to become a new Melmetal. It was first teased in Pokémon GO in 2018.
description.guide: Meltan is a Steel-type Mythical Pokémon based on a hex nut and the metal gallium, first found in Pokémon GO. It absorbs metal to generate electricity. It can evolve into Melmetal only in Pokémon GO.
description.tagline: A hex nut of liquid metal that eats metal for power

description.fun: Melmetal was worshipped in ancient times for its power to create metal from nothing, and ancient people made tools from the metal it shed. Its heavy hex-nut arms throw the strongest punches of any Pokémon, powered by centrifugal force. When it died 3,000 years ago, its followers sealed the Meltan born from its remains in Mystery Boxes so that Melmetal could one day return.
description.guide: Melmetal is a Steel-type Mythical Pokémon that evolves from Meltan in Pokémon GO. Its liquid-metal body has hardened, and its heavy hex-nut arms deliver the strongest punches of any Pokémon. It is the only Mythical Pokémon with a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: An ancient metal giant with the strongest punch of all

description.fun: Gigantamax Melmetal becomes a giant, cyclops-like figure from legend, its hex nuts reforming into huge fingers and fists. The liquid metal flowing inside it generates electricity, which it fires from its belly in beams that can vaporise a whole hill.

note.text: Meltan can only evolve in Pokémon GO, with 400 Meltan Candy; it can't evolve at all in the main series games.
